   READY   bloomery-serve-ds41
           -> http://127.0.0.1:8080

  serving ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  place    a
  context  2 slots x 16384 positions (32768 in all)
  cache    8.0 GiB of prompt cache in RAM

  try --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  $ curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions \
      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello!"}]}'

   Ctrl+C  stops the server     BLOOMERY_SCREEN=off  hides this screen     d  opens the live view
